notes.title: Bibble Girl - Update v1.4.0
notes.notes:
We've slightly reduced the difficulty of Endless Mode, reflecting player feedback that it was previously too challenging.
Additionally, all images provided through Endless Mode have now been fully unlocked.

Unless something special arises, this will likely be the final update for this game. 
Thanks to your continued support and valuable feedback, we've learned so much, and we promise to return with even more amazing content in the future.

Thank you all very much!

notes.title: Bubble Girl - Update v1.1.0 (January 26, 2025)
notes.notes:
1. Endless Mode Added

[list]
[*] To provide players with more diverse and rich content, we have introduced an Endless Mode.
[*] This mode features 20 randomly generated maps, and the color of the ball will change with each playthrough. Consequently, there may be certain maps that are more challenging to clear.
[*] Overall difficulty has been slightly increased compared to previous modes.
[*] 
[/list]

2. New Rewards in the Gallery (Related to Endless Mode)

[list]
[*] Players who clear a certain number of stages in Endless Mode will unlock a set of images, which can be viewed in the Gallery.
[*] The newly added images are static (non-animated). Initially, you will see unused images from the development process of Bubble Girl. Later on, test images for upcoming Ass Works projects will also be uploaded.
[*] Ten new images will be added every week, and the update speed may increase in the future.
[/list]

We are continually monitoring your feedback to provide an improved gaming environment. Please feel free to send us any suggestions at any time. We sincerely appreciate your continued support and hope you enjoy the new update.

notes.title: Progress Update on the 1st Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support and love for our game.
We’re excited to share the progress of the 1st Update with you today!

In this update, we’re introducing a brand-new feature: Endless Mode!
This mode allows players to accumulate points without limits, offering exciting challenges and special rewards as you reach higher scores.

Score-Based Reward System:

Reach 40 points → Unlock the 1st photo set 🎁
Reach 80 points → Unlock the 2nd photo set 🎁
Show off your skills in Endless Mode, unlock additional content, and enjoy a fresh gameplay experience!

Update Schedule
We are currently working on map design and difficulty adjustments to ensure a balanced and enjoyable experience.
As a result, the update is expected to take an additional 1-2 weeks to complete.

We are dedicated to providing you with the best content possible.
Thank you for your patience and understanding as we work to deliver a fantastic update. 🙏

notes.title: 🎉Bubble Girl Launches Soon!🎉
notes.notes:
🎉 Mark Your Calendars! Bubble Girl Launches Soon! 🎮

Hey everyone,
We’re super excited to share that Bubble Girl will officially launch on January 2, 2025, at 6:00 PM PST! 🥳 We've had so much fun bringing this game to life, and we can't wait for you to jump in and enjoy it.

On launch day, we’ll also post another update with some extra details, so be sure to check back. Your support has been amazing, and we’re so happy to have you with us as we get ready to release the game.

Let’s make this launch a memorable one together! 🚀
